term: tener a alguien sentado en el baúl

1.consolidated_definition: ‘Aplícase al marido dominado por su esposa’, Maura. “El sol es marido sentado en el baúl y no sale.” Luis Rafael Sánchez, En cuerpo de camisa, p. 78.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Applies to a husband dominated by his wife, Maura. "The sun is a husband sitting in the trunk and does not emerge." Luis Rafael Sánchez, En cuerpo de camisa, p. 78.

Translation:
Applies to a husband dominated by his wife, Maura. "The sun is a husband seated in the trunk and does not exit."
